objective: execute the complete first DXVK swapchain-blit render command family through real game command buffers instead of advancing one resolver name per deployment

transport.strict_shape: one canonical command-batch record per request

validation.client: exact bounded dynamic-rendering, one-viewport, one-scissor, graphics-pipeline, push-constant, and draw shapes
validation.service: typed command-buffer/device plus image-view/image/device, pipeline/device, and pipeline-layout/device ancestry
validation.shared: whole immutable stream is validated before any native replay and begin/end rendering balance is required
validation.fake_native: exact begin, pipeline, viewport, scissor, descriptor, push, draw, end topology

reuse: The required deja queries returned no indexed implementation. E101 reuses E056 typed descriptor ancestry, E075/E075a immutable transactional command streams, E076 general command records and zero-recording-RTT path, E096 template metadata, and the pinned DXVK swapchain blitter sequence.
